siteAccess.title: Limited site access detected
siteAccess.body: Your browser is restricting Vault's access to web pages. Allow access to all websites so Vault can block them.
siteAccess.grantFailed: The browser did not grant access. Check the extension’s site-access settings.
language.label: Language
manual.title: User manual
manual.error: Could not load the instruction manual.
manual.mtBanner: This manual is machine-translated. Phrasing may be rough; the English version is the source of truth.
settings.title: Vault settings
settings.copy: These settings apply to Vault rather than one blocking group.
settings.quitRetryMinutes: Ask a blocked app to quit again every (minutes)
settings.quitRetryMinutesHelp: A blocked app (or one a custom rule closes) is asked to quit normally, like ⌘Q; if it stays open, for example to keep unsaved work, it is left open. Above 0, it is asked again this often while it stays open.
settings.invalidValue: That value isn't allowed; the last saved value stays.
connectionGroup.warnMemberOffline: A linked program is offline — open it to keep linked groups in sync.
settings.localFolderCopy: Grant a folder for custom rules to read and write .txt, .csv, and .json files. Paths stay inside this folder.
settings.localFolderStatusNeedsPermissio: Access to {name} needs permission again. Restore access to use this folder.
settings.localFolderUnsupported: This browser does not support folder access here.
groups.title: Blocking groups
groups.copy: Drag groups to reorder them. Each group has its own rules and toggle.
groups.deleteAllDisabled: Delete all groups is unavailable while a frozen group's wait is still running.
editor.title: Group settings
editor.copy: Add one website per line. Domains and full URLs are both accepted.
editor.exportGroupPromptCopied: The group string was copied to your clipboard. You can also copy it from here.
editor.importGroupPrompt: Paste a group string to import.
editor.typeSummaryYouTube: Type: YouTube and video blocking group. Creator filters apply on YouTube, and short-vs-long video matching also works on supported video sites.
editor.typeSummaryTikTok: Type: TikTok blocking group. Filter by content type and creator when available.
editor.typeSummaryFacebook: Type: Facebook blocking group. Filter by content type and creator when available.
editor.typeSummaryInstagram: Type: Instagram blocking group. Filter by content type and creator when available.
editor.typeSummaryTwitch: Type: Twitch blocking group. Filter by content type and creator when available.
editor.typeSummaryReddit: Type: Reddit blocking group. Leave the subreddit list empty to apply to all Reddit, or target only specific subreddits.
editor.typeSummaryDiscord: Type: Discord blocking group. Filter by server when available.
editor.typeSummaryTwitter: Type: Twitter / X blocking group. Leave the account list empty to apply to all of Twitter / X, or target only specific accounts.
editor.typeSummaryCustom: Custom rules respond to events and decide what to block.
mode.afterMinutes: Block when the time allowance is used
timed.resetAtMidnight: Also restart the reset cycle at midnight
timed.rollingLimit: Rolling limit: used time comes back once it is older than the reset interval
platform.help.twitter: Add one @handle (or profile link) per entry. Targeted accounts are blocked on {platform}; everything else is left alone.
platform.videoModeHelp: Which kinds of content this group targets.
platform.authorModeHelp: Choose which creators this group targets. Content from other creators is unaffected.
platform.accountModeHelp: Pick which accounts this group targets. Only targeted content is blocked; everything else is left alone.
platform.authorMode.exclude: Apply to all {noun} except certain ones
platform.rulesCopy: Choose the content this group targets. Its blocking behavior applies only to matching content.
scopes.label: Applies to
scopes.browserOwnedHint: Websites and platforms are set in the browser extension; Mac Vault only controls apps.
scopes.pageAction: When a page of this entry is blocked
scopes.pageActionPause: Pause first, then let it through
platform.help.youtube: Choose creators on {platform}, or target a supported content type.
platform.help.generic: Creator filters work where Vault can identify the creator. Content types include {shortLabel}, {longLabel}, and {postLabel} where supported.
surfaceHide.contentHelp: Hide the supported parts of a page that you choose. You can combine these controls.
surfaceHide.genericAdWarning:
Heads up: hiding ads can violate this platform's Terms of Service and may get your account suspended or banned. Turn this on at your own risk.

Enable ad hiding anyway?
surfaceHide.youtube.shorts: Hide the Shorts button and shelves
surfaceHide.adWarning:
Heads up: hiding ads can violate this platform's Terms of Service and may get your account suspended or banned. Turn this on at your own risk.

Enable "Hide home feed ads" anyway?
surfaceHide.facebook.reels: Hide the Reels link and shelves
discord.modeExclude: Apply to all except certain servers/channels
discord.targetsHelp: Add one Discord server ID or channel ID per entry. Both kinds may be mixed. Plain snowflake IDs and links of the form discord.com/channels/<serverId> or discord.com/channels/<serverId>/<channelId> are accepted; channel links keep the channel ID as the entry. A page matches if its server OR its channel appears in the list.
status.allowlistWarning: Allow-list mode often leaves the feed empty or full of ads. The platform may still recommend other content.
status.discordAllowlistWarning: Allow-list mode blocks every server and channel you did not list. Direct messages and @me pages are not server- or channel-specific and may stay accessible.
custom.title: Custom rule
custom.editorCopy: Custom rules are event-driven. The script registers handlers that run across tabs and navigations until you click Run again, disable the group, or delete it.
custom.runStatusHalted: Rule stopped: loading took too long. Check the code for an infinite loop, then try Run again.
custom.runStatusSandboxTimeout: Rule stopped: it ran for more than 5 seconds without yielding and was disabled. Check the code for an infinite loop, then try Run again.
custom.runStatusQuarantined: Rule stopped: {reason}. The rule was disabled.
schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.copy: Limit this group to certain days or time windows.
schedule.help: Leave blank to apply all day. One range per line, like 09:00-10:00.
freeze.title: Freeze
freeze.waitHelp: 0 = no wait. While frozen the wait can only be made longer.
freeze.pinSet: A PIN is needed to unfreeze.
freeze.notStricter: While frozen the wait can only be made longer.
link.enforceOnly: Mac Vault is offline. This group still applies here, but cannot be edited. Open Mac Vault to reconnect.
snooze.title: Snooze
snooze.customCopy: Custom rules don't snooze: pressing Snooze sends the rule a "snooze" event, and the rule decides what happens.
snooze.warning.snoozePressFailed: The snooze event didn't reach the rule.
snooze.summary.pending: Snooze starts in {delay}, then runs for {time}.
snooze.summary.pendingBudget: An extra {time} will be added to the allowance in {delay}.
snooze.summary.activeBudget: An extra {time} was added to the allowance. Unused extra time expires in {until}.
snooze.summary.cooldown: Snooze ended. This group is active again. Another snooze is available in {time}.
snooze.warning.disabled: Snooze is disabled for this group.
snooze.warning.disabledFrozen: Snooze was disabled before this group was frozen, so it cannot be snoozed now.
snooze.warning.pending: A snooze is already scheduled. It starts in {time}.
snooze.warning.active: This group is already snoozed for {time} more.
snooze.warning.activeBudget: Extra allowance is still available. It expires in {time}, or when used up.
snooze.warning.cooldown: Snooze is cooling down for {time} more.
snooze.confirmationMessage: Confirmations required: {count}. Wait {seconds} seconds between confirmations.
sites.label: Blocked websites
sites.allowlistHelp: When on, this group blocks the entire web except the sites listed above (an allowlist). When off, it blocks only the listed sites.
modal.unfreezeMessageDefault: Are you sure you want to give up your self-discipline?
unfreeze.message.1: Are you sure you want to give up your self-discipline?
unfreeze.message.2: One deep breath. Are you really choosing distraction right now?
unfreeze.message.3: Future you is watching. Still want to weaken this rule?
unfreeze.message.4: That urge will pass. Are you certain you want to open this door?
unfreeze.message.5: Discipline is expensive to build and cheap to lose. Continue?
unfreeze.message.6: You made this guardrail for a reason. Do you want to lower it?
unfreeze.message.7: This is your focused self asking for one more pause. Continue?
unfreeze.message.8: Temptation sounds reasonable for a minute. Are you still sure?
unfreeze.message.9: If you confirm, your willpower has to work harder later. Continue?
unfreeze.message.10: This click is not neutral. Do you still want to give in?
empty.noGroups: No blocking groups yet. Add your first group to begin.
chip.invalid: Not a valid entry — fix or remove it.
tagFilter.help: Filter content using its Classifier tags. One rule per line: "Gaming" matches that tag; "Gaming @3" sets a minimum confidence; "Gaming + Drama" requires both; "!Tutorial" makes an exception.
tagFilter.blockUntagged: Also block content with no confident tag
tagFilter.blockPage: Also cover a matching content page
tagFilter.coverUntilTagged: Cover content until it has been tagged
tagFilter.available: Tags in your classifier (click to add):
filter.blockHomePageDiscordHelp: Blocks the Discord DMs home screen (/channels/@me).
filter.fallbackUrl: When blocked: redirect address or message
filter.fallbackUrlPlaceholder: https://example.com — or a message to show
filter.fallbackUrlHelp: Leave empty and a blocked page is covered in place — nothing on it is lost, and it comes back when the block lifts. Any other text is shown on that cover. A web address sends the tab there instead (a pause never redirects).
freeze.summary.notFrozen: Freeze this group to stop future edits.
freeze.pin.unfreezePrompt: Enter this group’s 6-digit PIN to unfreeze it.
freeze.settings.title: PIN settings
freeze.settings.setPrompt: Set a 6-digit PIN. You'll need it to unfreeze this group.
freeze.settings.managePrompt: Enter the current PIN to verify or clear it.

logFeed.title: Log
logFeed.hint: Output from v.log() in this group’s custom rule.
logFeed.empty: No output from this rule yet. Call v.log("hello") in a handler to add an entry.
classifierBridge.title: Vault Classifier
classifierBridge.collectionHelp: Only rendered public content is sent while collection is on. Ads and page entries are not retained by the extension.
platform.sourceModeHelp.reddit: Choose which Reddit communities (subreddits) this group targets. Other communities are unaffected.
platform.help.reddit: Use one subreddit per line. Plain names like `productivity` and paths like `r/productivity` are both accepted.
apps.label: Blocked apps
apps.help: Add the apps you want this group to block. Use the plus button to search installed apps.
apps.pickerCopy: Choose an installed app for this group.
apps.readOnlyHint: Edited in the linked desktop app. Shown here read-only.
status.invalidPauseSeconds: Pause seconds must be a whole number from 1 to 600.
settings.quickAddHelp: A tiny "+" at the bottom right of every page (and of the desktop) adds the current site or app to the group whose "+" badge you chose in the list.
apps.allowlistHelp: When on, this group blocks every app except those listed above. System apps, browsers, and Vault itself are excluded from blocking. When off, it blocks only the listed apps.

link.noCandidates: No group in another program to link with yet.
link.linkedWith: Linked with {names}. Unlinking keeps each group and its settings; targets remain specific to each program.
